summary: Iteration-4 testing of the premium redesign + live template preview + AI full-site generation. Backend: 45/45 pytest tests PASS (added TestAIGenerateTemplate with 4 tests — auth guard, empty-prompt 400, full E2E generate+persist, from-ai unauth). AI E2E call to POST /api/ai/generate-template with prompt 'مقهى مختص بالقهوة في الرياض' returned a valid schema (name + config.pages[0].sections with hero/services/text/faq/contact/footer) in ~7s; POST /api/sites/from-ai persisted it as a draft site with template_name='بالذكاء الاصطناعي' and a unique subdomain. Frontend: /templates page loads 30 template cards, category filter renders, LivePreview overlay opens with SectionRenderer inside a browser-chrome frame, desktop/mobile device toggles work (maxWidth 1180 / 400 via framer-motion layout), close button removes the overlay, 'استخدم هذا القالب' links to /register. Verified template-scoped brand colors ACTUALLY apply per-template — read `--brand-primary` from the TemplateTheme inner div for 4 templates: نشاط تجاري #0A2540, مطعم وكافيه #7C2D12, عقارات #1C1917, نادي رياضي #18181B (all distinct). Screenshot of the restaurant preview shows a warm brown/orange hero + amber button, clearly NOT the navy business palette — the previously reported 'everything looks navy' complaint is fixed. AI full-site flow via UI: registered fresh customer, opened create-site dialog, typed the coffee-shop prompt, clicked توليد, navigated to /editor/<id> with a fully generated Arabic site (hero 'مختصون في تقديم القهوة بروح الرياض', خدماتنا with 3 services, عن المقهى, FAQs, contact form + footer). Success toast 'تم إنشاء الموقع بالذكاء الاصطناعي' visible in editor.

issues: When measuring CSS vars in tests, note that the preview-canvas parent inherits the platform brand vars; only the inner TemplateTheme div carries the template-scoped --brand-primary. Consider forwarding the CSS vars onto data-testid='preview-canvas' too so debugging/inspection is easier — not a user-visible bug.

critical_code_review_comments: ai.generate_template does JSON parsing via txt[txt.find('{'): txt.rfind('}')+1] — brittle. If the LLM emits nested JSON with a trailing '}' after the top-level object it still slices correctly by luck, but consider using a strict JSON-mode call or try/except with re.search on the first balanced object. Also no length cap on prompt / sections — a malicious user could ask for 100 sections and store a giant doc.

sites.create_site_from_ai does NOT re-validate section types against the whitelist (hero|text|services|gallery|testimonials|team|pricing|cta|faq|contact|footer|store|logos|map). If the LLM hallucinates an unknown 'type', the site will be persisted and later rendered as a no-op. Add a server-side filter matching SectionRenderer's supported set.

TemplateTheme sets --brand-primary/secondary/accent only on ITS own div, so any element rendered OUTSIDE that wrapper (e.g. an accidental portal / tooltip using brand vars) falls back to the platform navy. Fine today, worth documenting.

Prior iterations' comments still stand (raw reset token in logs, contact-notification blocks store checkout, StoreOrderBody no price/qty validation, no pagination on /api/account/store-orders, PUT /admin/settings clobbers integrations sub-doc).
